newsitem.title: USA: Firefighters battle Shell Houston refinery fire.
newsitem.headline: Firefighters battle Shell Houston refinery fire.

text.p: Firefighters on Thursday were battling a gasoline tank fire at Shell Oil Co's 215,900 barrel per day Deer Park, Texas refinery near Houston, officials said.
Local firefighters joined the refinery fire brigade in battling the blaze, which apparently was sparked by a lightning strike, officials said.

The blaze was quickly brought under control and contained to a tank holding "a small amount" of a gasoline blending component on the chemical side of the complex along the Houston Ship Channel, a Shell spokeswoman said.
There were no injuries and operations at the refinery and chemical plant were unaffected, she said.
Residents near the refinery were warned to remain indoors while the fire burned itself out, officials said.
